eps.d: A client insists that Remington Steele personally oversee the protection of a shipment of rare jewels and Laura encounters a suave mystery man when he attempts to acquire the gems.
A $10 million lawsuit threatens to destroy the agency after the failure of an oil millionaire's "foolproof" burglar alarm.
The president of a video-game company hires the Steele Agency to find his partner who absconded with $5 million.
Laura and Steele spend the weekend trying to keep a CIA researcher alive and on time for his wedding.
A woman from Steele's past asks him to help her steal a valuable painting that Laura has already agreed to protect, while Laura also has to deal with her visiting mother.

A hard-luck client comes to the agency for help but his alibi witness is found dead in Steele's apartment and his defense attorney is more interested in Laura than in keeping his client off of Death Row.
The agency investigates the murder of an author whose steamy novels badly fictionalize her turbulent married life.

eps.t: Your Steele the One For Me
eps.d: A lesson in detective work escalates a jaywalking accident into a confrontation with Japanese gangsters.

eps.t: In the Steele of the Night
eps.d: Steele investigates when Laura's reunion with former colleagues disintegrates into grievances and murder.
To find out why a client committed suicide, Laura and Steele go undercover to an island party, where people are being murdered one by one.
An aging B-movie queen's fear for her life inspires Remington's sympathy and Laura's skepticism.
Steele gets involved with the murder of a naturalist when he serves on a committee to protect the bald eagle.
As physician and patient, Laura and Remington infiltrate a hospital to find missing morphine and a doctor.
Remington and Laura pose as an unhappily married couple to discover who is trying to kill a divorce lawyer.
Hired by separate clients, Remington and Laura try to outdo each other in a search for a 60-carat jewel.

eps.t: Steele Crazy After All These Years
eps.d: Remington and Laura investigate at Murphy's college homecoming after an alumnus is murdered.
An artist's apparent death yields suspects, but Remington and Laura can locate neither body nor paintings.
The detectives try to solve a case of sabotage and murder on the set of a television news program.
Laura's former flame seeks her help when he finds a body in the trunk of his car - a body that keeps reappearing as they investigate the winery their client is involved with.
The theft of a gold prospector's notebook at a costume party leads to a frantic, murderous treasure hunt.
Visits by Remington's mentor and Laura's mother cause complications.
The disappearance of $2.3 million from a federal reserve bank leads Remington and Laura into the world of punk rock.

Laura returns to Acapulco after a dying man leaves a tuna stuffed with diamonds and wrapped in an Acapulco newspaper on her doorstep. Steele joins her while trying to avoid a dogged IRS investigator, Mildred Krebs.
After a widow seeking control of her late spouse's aviation company hires Laura and Remington, corporate saboteurs blow up Laura's home.
An amnesiac man hires the agency to find out who he really is… and they discover that he has five different lives. As well as five different wives.
Steele accidentally runs over and kills a man, and he and Laura set out to determine who the man was and why he was coming to the agency.
Steele and Laura become art thieves to investigate the disappearance of a reporter who disappeared after making a major purchase.
The agency is hired to find a missing 1936 Speedster which holds the key to a lost treasure.
A poisoned TV dinner accidentally kills a parrot during the filming of a commercial, and the two human actors each think they were the intended victim.
Laura and Remington's complex case involves a body, a boxer, an abandoned baby and an underworld boss.
A dying tacoon hires the agency to find the twin sister of his adopted daughter.
Laura and Steele are called in to investigate industrial espionage in the fashion industry.
Steele becomes the target of a murderer after he's nominated one of the five most eligible bachelors in LA.
Mildred gets the agency involved in an investigation at a circus.
The government hires the agency to protect the two children of an expatriate returning to the U.S. to testify against his former employer.
Laura's brother-in-law asks the agency for help proving that he's not an adulterer. However, they soon get roped into a case of arson and murder.
Major Descoine returns to get vengeance on Laura... and Steele, who Descoine believes put him away.
Laura and Steele go to a small town to look for a missing historian, and get involved in a secret someone is willing to kill to protect.
A woman hires the agency to find out how her name and phone number appeared in a swingers magazine, and put a stop to it.
The agency is set up when they're hired to protect precious gems... that are secretly switched for fakes.
The agency is hired to protect an art collection from a female swindler, who is connected to Steele's mysterious past.
An Interpol agent secretly hires Mildred to recover a doig... which belongs to a jewel thief that the agent wants to steal for him.
A woman hires the agency to protect her from... Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson.
The agency's trip to the French Riviera gets complicated when Steele's old friend asks him for help with a robbery.
An ex-con resorts to burglary and arson to get at loot hidden in Laura's new apartment.
While looking foir a missing corpse on Malta, Laura and Steele stumble across an ancient antique cross.
A man hires the agency to investigate a series of suspicous accidents at a spots team that his former high school team is attending.
Daniel Chalmers shows up to rope Steele into a con in England posing as the heir to a family fortune.
Laura finds Steele in Ireland, suffering from amnesia after leaving without a word. She soon breaks him out and they set out to find out what is going on.
A teenage oy pickpockets Steele's wallet, putting him in the middle of a case the agency is investigating.
A millionaire tries to divide Steele and Laura with a wager that they can't find a missing writer in 48 hours.
Actors Lloyd Nolan, Dorothy Lamour, and Virginia Mayo hire the agency to discover who is threatening them.
Laura and Steele try to protect two singing-telegram girls who witnessed a murder while they also hunt for the killers.
Someone embezzles a million dollars from a mystery writer's guild, and the guild hires Laura and Steele to investigate.
A magazine's food critic goes missing and the publishers hires the agency to find the man.
Laura insists on taking the case of a TV actor accused of murder. The actor played Atomic Man, the superhero that Laura based her Remington Steele on.

eps.t: Have I Got a Steele For You
eps.d: A suspicious wife hires the agency to investigate a company that is apparently trying to swindle her husband.
A Texas tycoon joins in Laura and Remington's search for the shady talent agents who want to prevent a singer's rise to stardom.
Mildred's nephew has a little problem: he needs to hide a body from a hit man who needs the corpse to confirm his kill.
An investigator from an insurance company digs into Steele's past after the agency loses their money in an effort to buy back stolen jewels.

eps.t: Now You Steele It, Now You Don't
eps.d: An antique dealer hires Laura to track down a kleptomaniac, but the trail leads to murder.
The agency helps a comic book inker who is working on a strip featuring the exploits of a detective similar to Steele.
The agency gets swept up in an investigation concerning a missing no-calorie chocolate chip cookie formula, and the person who created it.
Steele hires a con woman to convince Laura that they have a case in San Francisco so they can spend some quality time together. However, they soon get swept up into a murder.
The agency becomes involved in a Senatorial race when they're hired to vet a candidate... who someone takes a shot at.
Steele goes missing, and Laura and Mildred trace him to the UK... where he's looking for his father, a possible serial killer.
Steele is mistaken for hit man and given the job of killing the man who may be his father.
The Feds are looking for a photographer who has ties to Laura... and Laura has gone missing.
The agency enters the world of pro wrestling when a wrestler hires them to protect him from a killer.
Steele wakes up from a hangover and learns that he lost the agency in a bet... and is accused of stealing diamonds.
The agency goes in whole-hog when they're hired to locate missing pigs after Mildred has invested the agency's profits in the company.
A man hires the agency to discover why he has an obituary in the paper... and he's not the only one.
The agency tries to solve a murder aboard a first-class airplane before news of the death gets out and ruins the company.
The agency Christmas party is interrupted by three gun-wielding Santas who take everyone hostage and threaten to blow up the building.
Laura witnesses the "accidental" death of an air traffic reporter, but believes that it was murder and investigates.
A man whose ID says that he's Steele turns up at the morgue, and it leads back to idea man George Mulch.
The son of a caviar magnate hires the agency to discover where a load of caviar has disappeared.
Laura's suburban sister calls the agency to report a dead man in her kitchen.

eps.t: Santa Claus is Coming to Steele
eps.d: One of the Santas who held the sleuths hostage on Christmas Eve is out on bail and eager to "persuade" the witnesses not to testify against him.
A woman hires the agency to watch her father, who she claims is insane. However, they soon learn that he's anything but.
Laura and Steele poses as a married couple to infiltrate a counseling group, and end up discussing their feelings for each other.
The spotlight is on Laura after a TV-magazine show hires the agency to find an actress who vanished in the 1950s.
The servants of the wealthy Wellingtons hire Laura and Steele to find out who killed the former butler, who had planned on publishing his memoirs.
While competing in a triathalon, Laura is first abducted and then dumped.
Laura and Steel return from an out-of-town case and discover that everyone thinks that they've been murdered.
A man who framed himself so his wife could collect the reward learns he isn't terminally ill and wants Laura and Steele to clear him.
Steele starts disappearing, leaving Laura in the lurch, as the agency investigates a boss' body that turns up unexpectedly dead.
While honeymooning in Mexico, Steel and Laura are framed for a crime that they didn't commit.
Steele and Laura return to Los Angeles and find a woman from Remington's past as well as persistent agent Roselli.
Dogged by Roselli, Remington and Laura fly to London in pursuit of a stolen painting.
Accused of being a double agent, Tony hides out in Steele's newly inherited Irish castle, but the estate security chief has other plans for him.
Daniel Chalmers plots to deliver Tony into the hands of the KGB, while Remington learns his father's identity.
